product_overview: Mahalak POS is a web-based point-of-sale cashier system for multi-type retail stores (including pharmacy-specific features) accessible at /pos/qpos. It provides product browsing, barcode scanning, customer management, payments, shift management, holds, returns, and pharmacy workflows integrated with Firestore and Firebase Auth.
core_goals: Enable authenticated store owners to perform full POS checkout flows from product selection to receipt generation.
Provide fast product search, barcode scanning, and voice search to accelerate cashier throughput.
Support retail and pharmacy-specific requirements: expiry tracking, prescriptions, insurance claims, and drug alternatives.
Persist POS transactional and operational data in Firestore (sales, held carts, returns, shifts, customers, coupons, prescriptions, insurance claims).
Support cashier workflows: hold/resume carts, returns, shifts, coupons, and customer linking with clear error handling.

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Login and registration via email/password using Firebase Auth to restrict POS access to store owners/sellers.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth -> Toggle between login and register tabs -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click login button to submit -> Redirect to /pos/qpos
Navigate to /auth -> Fill email input field with invalid email -> Fill password input field -> Click login button to submit -> See error message on invalid credentials -> Stay on /auth
Navigate to /auth -> Toggle to register tab -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click create account -> See confirmation or redirect to /pos/qpos on success
Navigate to /auth -> Click forgot password link -> Navigate to /auth/forgot-password -> Fill email -> Submit reset -> See confirmation or error if email not found

features.name: Product Management & Cart
features.description: Browse store products in a grid, add items to cart, adjust quantities, remove items, and view totals in real time.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> View product grid with images, names, and prices -> Click a product card to add it to the cart -> See cart items in right panel with updated quantity and totals -> Click plus button to increment quantity -> See line total update
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> View product grid -> Click same product card twice -> See quantity increment twice in cart -> Click trash icon next to item -> See item removed and totals updated
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Add multiple products to cart -> Click clear cart button -> Confirm clear action -> See cart emptied and totals reset
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Attempt to add product flagged expired at checkout -> See warning or blocked message during checkout -> Prevent completing payment

features.name: POS Barcode Scanner
features.description: Scan product barcodes with device camera to add items to the cart; manual barcode entry as fallback.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click barcode scanner button in header -> Allow camera access when prompted -> Point camera at product barcode -> Product auto-added to cart on successful scan -> See cart updated

Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click barcode scanner button in header -> Deny camera permission when prompted -> See permission denied error -> Enter barcode manually in text input -> Click submit manual barcode -> See product added to cart

Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click barcode scanner button in header -> Allow camera -> Point at unknown barcode -> See product not found message -> Use manual barcode entry fallback -> See not found error persisted

features.name: Search & Filter (including Voice Search)
features.description: Real-time text and voice search and category filters to quickly locate products.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Use search bar to filter products by name -> See filtered grid with matching products -> Click product to add to cart
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Use category tabs to filter -> See grid filtered by selected category -> Click product to add to cart
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click voice search button -> Allow microphone access when prompted -> Speak search query (Arabic) -> See filtered results matching spoken query
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Use search bar with query that yields no matches -> See 'no products found' message

features.name: Payment & Checkout
features.description: Complete sales with cash, card, or split payments; generate receipts and save sale records to Firestore.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Add items to cart -> Click payment button to open payment modal -> Select payment method - cash -> Enter amount received -> See change calculated -> Click confirm sale button to process payment -> See success confirmation with sale details -> Click print receipt button

Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Add items to cart -> Click payment button to open payment modal -> Select payment method - card -> Enter card details or choose card option -> Click confirm sale button -> See success confirmation and receipt options

Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Add items to cart -> Click payment button -> Select split payment -> Enter cash amount -> Enter card amount -> See totals balanced -> Click confirm sale -> See success and sale saved to Firestore

Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Add items to cart -> Click payment button -> Select cash -> Enter amount less than total -> Click confirm sale -> See validation error 'insufficient amount' -> Remain in payment modal

features.name: Hold Cart (تعليق الفاتورة)
features.description: Pause current cart with an optional note and resume or delete held carts later.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Add items to cart -> Click hold cart button in header -> Enter optional note for the held cart -> Confirm hold action -> See confirmation and cart cleared from workspace

Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click held carts list button -> See list of held carts with timestamps and notes -> Click resume button on a held cart -> Held cart restored to right panel with items and quantities
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click held carts list -> Click delete on a held cart -> Confirm delete -> See held cart removed from list
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Add items to cart -> Click hold cart -> Network error occurs on save -> See error message and cart remains active

features.name: POS Customer Management (إدارة العملاء)
features.description: Create, search, and link customers to sales; update purchase history after each sale.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click customers button in header -> Search customers by phone number -> See matching customers list -> Select existing customer to link to current sale -> See customer linked indicator in sale

Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click customers button -> Click add new customer button -> Fill customer name -> Fill phone -> Fill email and notes -> Click save new customer -> See new customer appear in list
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Complete sale linked to a customer -> See customer's total purchases and visit count auto-updated
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click customers button -> Attempt to create customer without phone -> See validation error 'phone required' -> Customer not saved

features.name: POS Returns & Refunds (المرتجعات)
features.description: Process returns and refunds by locating previous sales, selecting items, choosing return type and refund method, and restocking inventory.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click returns button in header -> Enter sale ID to search for original sale -> See sale details and items -> Select items to return -> Set return quantity -> Select return type 'refund' -> Select refund method 'cash' -> Enter return reason -> Confirm return -> See success message and inventory restocked
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click returns button -> Enter invalid sale ID -> Click search -> See 'sale not found' error -> Abort return flow
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click returns button -> Enter sale ID -> Select items and choose exchange -> Confirm exchange -> See exchange record created and inventory updated

features.name: POS Shift Management (الوردية)
features.description: Open and close cashier shifts, track starting and ending cash, sales count, and handle discrepancies.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click shift button in header -> Enter starting cash amount -> Click open shift button -> See active shift info in header with sales count and total

Navigate to /pos/qpos -> With active shift -> Click close shift button -> Enter ending cash amount -> See cash difference calculation -> Enter close notes for discrepancies -> Confirm shift close -> See shift closed confirmation
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click shift button -> Enter starting cash invalid value (non-numeric) -> Click open shift -> See validation error -> Shift not opened

features.name: POS Coupons & Discounts (الكوبونات)
features.description: Create, manage, and apply coupons (percentage or fixed) at checkout with validation for expiry and usage limits.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click coupons button in header -> Click create new coupon -> Enter coupon code -> Select type percentage -> Enter value and expiry -> Set usage limit -> Save new coupon -> See coupon in list
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Add items to cart -> Click payment button -> Enter valid coupon code in payment modal -> Click apply -> See discount reflected in total -> Confirm sale
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Add items to cart -> Click payment -> Enter expired coupon code -> Click apply -> See 'coupon expired' error -> Coupon not applied

features.name: Pharmacy Expiry Tracking (تتبع الصلاحية)
features.description: Show expiry badges, alert on near/critical expiry, warn or block sales of expired items.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> See expiry badges on product cards showing days until expiry -> Click expiry alerts button in header -> View list of critical (red) and warning (orange) expiry alerts
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Add near-expiry product to cart -> Attempt checkout -> See near-expiry warning confirmation prompt -> Confirm to proceed -> Complete sale
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Add expired product to cart -> Attempt checkout -> See 'product expired' blocked error -> Prevent sale completion

features.name: Pharmacy Prescription Management (إدارة الروشتات)
features.description: Record prescriptions for Rx products, require prescription data at checkout, and allow searching prescription history.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Add Rx product to cart -> Prescription modal auto-opens -> Enter doctor name -> Enter patient name -> Enter patient phone -> Enter diagnosis -> Save prescription -> Complete payment -> See prescription linked to sale
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click prescriptions button (روشتات) -> Search prescriptions by patient name -> See matching prescription records -> Click record to view details
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Add Rx product to cart -> Prescription modal opens -> Leave required field blank -> Click save -> See validation error -> Prevent proceeding to payment

features.name: Pharmacy Insurance Claims (التأمين الصحي)
features.description: Manage insurance companies and create claims during pharmacy sales with copay calculations.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click insurance button in header -> View insurance companies list -> Click add new insurance company -> Enter name and coverage percentage -> Save company -> See company in list

Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Add eligible items to cart -> Click payment -> Select insurance company -> Enter policy number -> See copay amount auto-calculated -> Confirm sale -> Insurance claim auto-created and saved
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click insurance -> Attempt to select inactive insurance company during checkout -> See 'company inactive' error -> Cannot select company

features.name: Pharmacy Drug Alternatives (البدائل الدوائية)
features.description: Find and add alternative drugs by active ingredient when a pharmacy product is selected.
user_flows: Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click alternatives button on a pharmacy product card -> See list of alternative drugs with name, manufacturer, price, availability -> Click add button on alternative -> See alternative added to cart
Navigate to /pos/qpos -> Click alternatives on product -> Alternatives list empty -> See 'no alternatives found' message
